notes: No SVG qualifies. SMSAPI's official logo kit (https://cdn.smsapi.com/static/files/SMSAPI_Logo_kit.zip, linked from the archived smsapi.com/en/press; saved downloads/smsapi/src5, PDFs and PNGs extracted to src5/kit) has only AI/EPS/PDF/PNG files of two things: the 'SMSAPI' wordmark (Logo/) and a long key visual of speed lines ending in an envelope (KV/). The app mark (a compact envelope with two short blue lines) is drawn differently from the key visual's end (other line lengths and splits), so it can't be cut from the kit's vectors without new geometry. smsapi.com's own 180px apple-touch-icon is yet another, tighter crop of the key visual that bleeds off the tile's left edge. The current file is the 'SMSAPI powered by LINK Mobility' wordmark (white letters, vanishes on light). The navy tile is the brand's app-icon tile and reads on both themes. www.smsapi.com and smsapi.pl are geo-blocked from here (/not-supported-country), but cdn.smsapi.com serves the same public files.
